content.short: Founded by Mike Novogratz and listed on Nasdaq, Galaxy offers institutions trading, lending, asset management and infrastructure.
content.description: Galaxy serves institutions across the crypto market. Its markets business runs electronic and OTC trading, crypto-backed loans and derivatives. Asset management covers ETFs and tokenized funds, and the GK8 platform provides custody and staking. Galaxy has also built large data centres for AI and high-performance computing. The company trades on Nasdaq as GLXY and has offices in the US, UK and Asia. GalaxyOne now brings cash, crypto, equities and yield into one platform for individual and institutional investors, and Helios is the company's AI data centre campus.
